description: Defines the LoadBalancerServerIdMap class template for managing server ID to data mappings with fixed length validation, using absl::flat_hash_map.

classes.name: LoadBalancerServerIdMap
classes.description: A template class that manages a mapping from server IDs to values of type T, ensuring all server IDs are of a fixed length.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new LoadBalancerServerIdMap with specified server ID length, returns nullptr if invalid.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Returns an optional reference to the value associated with a server ID, or an empty optional if not found or ID length mismatch.

methods.name: LookupNoCopy
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the value associated with a server ID, or nullptr if not found or ID length mismatch.

methods.name: AddOrReplace
methods.description: Associates a value with a server ID, replacing existing entry; logs bug if ID length is incorrect.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes the entry for a given server ID.

search-terms: quic load balancer server id map
